Liam: Quick heads-up — Citrine go-live warmup tomorrow AM. I sketched a short plan, need eng + oncall signoff on quotas, autoscale thresholds, and soak windows.
Priya: Thanks — paste the plan? will check autoscale limits against their traffic profile.
Liam: Plan (short):
- Reserve 75% of committed pool for steady traffic
- Allow 15% burst headroom for short spikes
- Autoscale: add 1 node at 60% avg GPU util, add 2 nodes at 75% sustained over 3m
- Canary in us-west-2 with 5% traffic for 30m, then region roll at 25% increments
- Soak tests: 2h at 60%, 1h at 80% (simulated), then failure injection
Priya: Sounds reasonable. two requests: make sure KV cache priming step runs before canary, and pin the quantized variant for canary to match perf.
Liam: Good call on KV priming. Added: run prefix-cache script x1 across sample prompts before canary.
Ethan: Oncall here — what are fallback policies if nodes drop during soak? need clear rollback triggers and SLOs.
Liam: Rollback triggers: error rate > 2% for 5m OR p95 latency > 2x baseline for 3m -> automatic traffic shift to hosted fallback model (smaller variant). Manual escalation if sustained.
Jade (Citrine): From Citrine side: we can hold feature flag to reduce QPS by 50% if needed. Also we'll run internal warmup at 06:00.
Priya: For autoscale policy, I'll add a cushion to avoid oscillation: cooldown 4m, min-replicas 2, max-replicas same as reserved pool size.
Liam: loadtest-bot will run the scripts. scheduling windows: 07:00 canary start, 07:30 regional ramp, 09:45 soak failure tests (node kill + network delay).
loadtest-bot: Scheduled: citrine_warmup_v2 at 2026-03-22T07:00Z, scripts: `warmup_prefix.sh`, `steady_load.py --rps 1200`, `chaos-shot.sh`.
Ethan: Oncall checklist: confirm KMS keys available, alert routing to #eng-oncall, increase observability retention to 7d for this job.
Priya: I'll pin model artifact to `rwd-quant-v1` for canary and produce perf baseline before 06:30.
Liam: Logging snippet to validate prime succeeded (run on each replica):
```
curl -s http://localhost:9100/health | jq .kv_cache | grep primed
```
Jade (Citrine): We will provide a small prompt set for quality checks. Can someone add it to the runbook?
Liam: Will do. final asks before tomorrow: Priya confirm autoscale config; Ethan confirm alert hooks; Jade confirm prompt set uploaded by EOD.
Priya: Confirmed I'll push autoscale config to staging tonight.
Ethan: Alert hooks set, slack paging test done.
Jade (Citrine): Prompt set uploaded to S3 path: s3://citrine-warmup/prompts/prime-set.json. Thanks team! :rocket:
Liam: Great — thanks everyone. Will post final runbook 30m before start. :thumbsup:
